notes: Windows updates itself now. The app checks for a new version when it starts and every few hours, shows a banner and a row under Settings > About, downloads the update when you ask and installs it on restart; the portable build swaps itself for the new file. This is the first version with the updater, so this one update is by hand: download it from the site. Earlier today: a file Windows refuses to open is converted as it plays instead of ending in a 3016 error, and a stream that really cannot play says what its host did.
